The platform comes first. Everything else runs on it.

Kubernetes platforms, the infrastructure underneath them and the private AI on top, built by the architect who scopes the work.

Talk about your projectWork with us as a partner

Every serious AI project becomes a platform project.

A model is easy to demo. Running one for a business takes GPU scheduling, data kept on premises, identity, an audit trail and a way back after failure. That is a platform, and once it exists it carries your applications, databases and pipelines as well. We build it once, properly, and AI is the workload we know best.

Four services, one platform underneath.

Each can be an engagement of its own or one stage of the same delivery. The platform comes first because everything else sits on it.

  1. 01

    OpenShift, Nutanix NKP or upstream Kubernetes, on bare metal or air-gapped. Capacity, recovery, upgrades and day-to-day ownership are designed in.

  2. 02

    Open-weight models served inside your network on vLLM or Triton, sized to the GPUs you own. Your data stays put, and there is no per-token bill.

  3. 03

    Which documents are authoritative, who may read them and how they stay current, settled before anything is indexed.

  4. 04

    What an agent may do on its own, and what waits for a person. Enforced by the execution layer, not requested in a prompt.
